exposure: Infant formula enriched with 5 g/l a1,2-fucosyllactose (2'-FL)
outcome: Gut microbial colonisation (anaerobic bacteria in caecal contents, gut microbiota composition)
Digestive function (hexose absorption, brush border enzyme activities)
cohort: Caesarean-delivered preterm pigs were randomized to receive either control formula or 2'-FL-enriched formula for 5 days.
finding: Formula enrichment with 2'-FL did not significantly affect gut microbiology, digestive function, or NEC sensitivity in preterm pigs within the first few days after preterm birth.
